messages.content: We have decided not to change hotels after all. Compare the Old San Juan and beachfront choices for all five nights, including fees, airport rides, Friday dinner transportation, cancellation, and Sunday bag storage.

For Tuesday, May 12 through Sunday, May 17, one room for two adults, the Old San Juan option is $2,486 total: $2,185 room and tax plus a $301 property charge. The Isla Verde beachfront option is $2,210 total, including taxes and its resort charge. The beach hotel is therefore $276 less before transportation.
What does transportation do to that difference? Our dinner Friday is still at 7:30 in Old San Juan.

From the airport, allow roughly $25-$35 to Old San Juan and $15-$22 to Isla Verde each way. At the historic hotel, Friday dinner is an eight-minute walk, so the five-night plan needs only the two airport rides: about $50-$70 total. From the beach hotel, add a Friday round trip to Old San Juan, approximately $70-$100 with evening demand. Its transportation estimate is about $100-$145. That puts the practical totals near $2,536-$2,556 downtown and $2,310-$2,355 beachfront. The beach option remains about $181-$246 cheaper.
Remind me what each rate includes. I do not want a lower headline price hiding another charge at checkout.

The quoted $2,486 historic-hotel total includes all five nights, estimated lodging taxes, the mandatory property charge, Wi-Fi, and rooftop pool access. Breakfast and parking are excluded. The $2,210 beachfront total includes all five nights, lodging taxes, and the daily resort charge; that charge covers beach chairs, towels, Wi-Fi, and the fitness center. Umbrellas, food, and parking cost extra. Neither quote includes transportation or optional hotel purchases.
And the cancellation deadlines? Give them in San Juan time, not Denver time.

The historic rate can be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Atlantic time on Thursday, May 7. After that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The beachfront rate is refundable through 11:59 p.m. Atlantic time on Tuesday, May 5; after the deadline, the full five-night amount is nonrefundable. Both require a card guarantee, but the historic hotel lists payment at check-in while the beach property may place a one-night authorization before arrival.
Sunday storage matters because the flight is not until 3:55. Which one will actually keep both bags long enough?

The historic hotel confirms complimentary storage for registered guests until 6:00 p.m. on checkout day, so collecting the bags around 1:15 is covered. The beachfront hotel offers complimentary storage only until 1:00 p.m.; storage after that depends on space and may carry a $10-per-bag charge. Its timing is possible but leaves little margin for your planned pickup.
The downtown hotel sounds easier, but quantify what we are paying for that convenience.

Using the midpoint of the ride estimates, the historic plan is about $2,546 and the beach plan about $2,333. You would pay roughly $213 more overall for the historic hotel. In return, Friday dinner is walkable, Sunday luggage storage is confirmed past your pickup time, the cancellation window is two days later and carries a smaller late-cancellation penalty, and you avoid two additional Friday car rides. The tradeoff is having a rooftop pool rather than direct beach access.
Choose the historic hotel. One room the whole time is more important, and I would rather not coordinate cars around the anniversary dinner. Use the king room we compared.

Selected: the historic Old San Juan hotel, Historic King room, for two adults and five consecutive nights, checking in Tuesday, May 12 and checking out Sunday, May 17. The displayed lodging total is $2,486 including estimated taxes and the mandatory property charge. Rooftop pool access and Wi-Fi are included; breakfast, parking, airport transfers, and incidental purchases are not.
Put the booking details and Sunday sequence in one final record. Also say what I still need to verify before entering the card.

Final hotel record: one Historic King room for Elena Ruiz and one accompanying adult, May 12-17, five nights, Old San Juan. Displayed total: $2,486, comprising room, estimated taxes, and the mandatory property charge. Card guarantee required; payment is listed for check-in. Free cancellation ends Thursday, May 7 at 6:00 p.m. Atlantic time, followed by a one-night-plus-tax penalty. Friday's 7:30 p.m. dinner is about an eight-minute walk. On Sunday, check out by 11:00 a.m., leave both bags with the hotel, collect them around 1:15 p.m., request a car by 1:25, depart near 1:30, and target SJU around 1:50 for the 3:55 p.m. flight. Before booking, verify live room inventory, the exact charged total and currency, the king-bed guarantee, deposit or authorization timing, the cancellation deadline and penalty on the final rate screen, and written confirmation that complimentary luggage storage remains available until at least 1:15 p.m. The hotel is selected but not yet booked.
